say:1:1331042001:1.text: Well... there was a lady at the ball who really resembled Neriah. I didn't look closely enough and mistook her for my wife.
say:1:1331042001:1.source_cn: 今年……今年舞会上有一个长得和娜杰很像的女士，我一时疏...
say:1:1331042001:1.male: Well... there was a lady at the ball who really resembled Neriah. I didn't look closely enough and mistook her for my wife.
say:1:1331042001:1.female: Well... there was a lady at the ball who really resembled Neriah. I didn't look closely enough and mistook her for my wife.

say:2:1331042002:1.text: Anyway, it was my fault, and I won't try to come up with any excuses this time.
say:2:1331042002:1.source_cn: 但我今年不想再找借口，不管怎么样，这次都是我的错误。

say:3:1331042003:1.text: Darling, what should I do to make you forgive me?
say:3:1331042003:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，我该怎么做你才肯原谅我？
